blocks.text: Team preview of the Chicago Bulls ahead of the 2026-2027 NBA season. Last NBA season: 31-51, missed playoffs. Coach: Tiago Splitter (first season with Bulls, second season overall, 42-39). Season Opener: Oct. 21 at Toronto. Departures: G Anfernee Simons, G Collin Sexton, C/PF Nick Richards. Addition: F Caleb Wilson, G Norman Powell, F Dailyn Swain, G/F Buddy Hield, C Nic Claxton. What to expect The Bulls are starting over. Bryson Graham took over the front office in May, and Splitter was hired as coach in June. Graham was Atlanta’s senior vice president of basketball operations last season after a 15-year run […]...
